scope: Static worldMaster text routing and parameter binding for clientbound CommandResultX01/X10/X18/X00 battle-result records.

directCallers.evidence: Passes param2=1 and param3=0, selecting FUN_0058C220's early return after header rendering.
Passes param2=0 and a nonnull param3 that the caller dereferences.

rowWorldMasterTextId.behavior: A zero value skips the row text path. A nonzero value is passed unchanged as the worldMaster row ID to the common renderer. The client does not derive a replacement outcome row from numericValue, effectId, commandId, or actor identity.

headerControlValue.behavior: A nonzero value is rendered once through FUN_005759A0 in the same worldMaster ID argument position with row-specific arguments zeroed, then cleared. It is a separate header-level text selection, not a modifier of per-row routing.

commandId.behavior: It is supplied to the template parameter builder but does not select the worldMaster row. Client-data joins establish table identity only.

presentationAndRenderContext.behavior: The header flags and render-context fields feed category and formatting state, but no static branch shows them replacing the server-carried worldMaster ID.

requirements: The caller must select a row-loop mode.
rowOrdinalOrFilter must satisfy the consumer's current filter.
FUN_005859F0 must admit the target/text-ID pair.
rowAdmission.admissionCeiling: FUN_005859F0 scans a 30-entry u16 table and has explicit handling for 0x8475 and 0x846E, but the complete semantic purpose of this gate is unresolved.

defaultRenderPipeline.role: Loads the server-carried text ID and row/header arguments.

Resolves actor context, computes the battle-log category through FUN_007641D0, builds template arguments through FUN_007705A0, and submits sheet 0x5FF80001 plus the low 16-bit worldMaster row ID to FUN_00771F50.
Creates the asynchronous text-expansion/logger object through FUN_0076B3D0 and installs the display-name resolver listener through FUN_00789CD0.

fetchRenderCeiling: The worldMaster sheet selector, row ID, typed parameter vector, actor-name resolver, and async expansion submission are statically proven. The lower sheet-row fetch is behind the text engine's asynchronous resolver and is not assigned a direct static callee by this pass.

parameterBindings.meaning: Source actor display-name/context substitution; the actor resolver is proven, but the complete queue +0x0C to resolver-object link is not closed.
Sheet-backed command/action/effect name; the literal template determines the referenced sheet family.
Generic numeric substitution used by damage, recovery, experience, chain, and other templates.
The row value is masked to 24 bits before insertion. Its displayed interpretation is template-specific.
Template-specific auxiliary value, observed in grammar, skill/body-part name, hit-count, and EXP-chain timer positions. It has no single global semantic.
Consumed as a row filter/ordinal after rendering; it is not inserted into the template parameter vector.

specialBranches.behavior: When target lookup and source-membership checks pass, calls FUN_00796F80(textParam), then continues through the default renderer. This is an actor-state side effect, not text suppression or alternate formatting.

Uses the same target lookup and source-membership gate and calls FUN_00796F80(0), then continues through the default renderer. The English table row contains asterisks, but the consumer does not suppress it.

For the local target, supplies numericValue and textParam to PlayerProfileWidget and numericValue to ChainBonusEffectWidget, then continues through the default renderer. The widgets are additional progression UI, not a replacement text path.

When target lookup succeeds, calls FUN_007975C0 on the target's +0xE4C component with numericValue and (textParam != 0), then continues through the default renderer. This is an experience/progression side effect. IDs 0x8493 and 0x8496-0x8498 are not members of this special set.

unresolvedBoundaries: Actor types cannot be inferred from the closed capture rows; only numeric actor IDs are retained.
The exact global semantics of textParam and rowOrdinalOrFilter do not exist as one proven enum; they are template-specific and filter-specific respectively.
0x013B has a complete static shape but no retained packet or row.
The lower asynchronous text-engine sheet fetch remains indirect below FUN_00771F50.
